title: Why it did or didn't trade

data.name: funnel / blocks / evaluations / decisions
data.shape: four independent StageResult reads — entries | none | unreadable, each on its own
data.source: app.readPipeline.execute — a candidate ends at one of three places: blocked before evaluation, evaluated and skipped, or decided against

components.purpose: The three stages a candidate meets, in order, each standing alone — plus the funnel that frames them.
components.current_implementation: max-w-3xl centered column, space-y-6, p-6, four sections, back link. The section heading is now 'Stopped by a gate' (was 'Stopped before evaluation'), the framing sentence names the stage BattleGrid gives rather than a pipeline position, and the empty state reads 'No candidate was stopped by a gate.' — v18 folded EVALUATION-stage rows in, so the old wording asserted something the platform contradicts.
constraints: Each stage renders on its own — one that cannot be read says so without hiding the two that answered.
'Nothing was blocked' and 'we could not ask what was blocked' send an operator to different places and must never render alike.

components.purpose: What an empty or unreadable stage says, per stage — the subject names the record, not the thing recorded.
components.current_implementation: Shared helper: the empty sentence states what the emptiness means; unreadable carries role=alert plus WhyNotLoaded with a per-stage subject.
constraints: Each subject names the record ('this agent's record of what stopped it is'), never the blocker — saying the blocker is gone is the opposite of what failed to load.

components.purpose: The frame: ten rows cannot say what '245 evaluations behind 73 entries' says.
components.current_implementation: One tokened card — the same shape the competitor page renders, and this figure existed for competitors before it existed for the user's own agents.
constraints: The two skip counters the platform names alike are labelled apart and never summed.
Fractions and platform-percentages go through separate formatters — one through the other renders 7600%.

components.purpose: Stopped before evaluation: the gate, the reason code, and the numbers that are the actual answer.
components.current_implementation: Tokened cards: reasonCode, coin or account-wide, gate stage, quantified reasonDetail pairs, timestamp.
constraints: The reasonDetail numbers are the answer; the code is only the label — both render.
A block with no coin says 'account-wide' rather than dropping the fact.

components.purpose: Evaluated: score against threshold, each row opening the full scorecard.
components.current_implementation: Tokened cards: coin (linked), score vs threshold, terminal status, triggered-of-required, bias, read direction, the per-card conflict line in words, gate status, timestamp.
constraints: The per-card conflict line stays in words — a notice block per card would out-shout the cards (DT-0009's ruling).
Score and threshold are fractions and render through the fraction formatter.

components.purpose: Decided: the agent's own reasoning whole, the geometry as it was at the decision, and the evidence it read.
components.current_implementation: Tokened cards: decision/coin/direction/conviction/status, 'At the decision' geometry, sizing, the reasoning whitespace-pre-wrap and unparaphrased, the Evidence disclosure, order ids, timestamp.
constraints: 'At the decision' is load-bearing copy: position management moves the stop after a trade opens, so this page and the agent page would otherwise show one word meaning two numbers.
The reasoning renders whole and unparaphrased.
The order-id thread from 'it decided' to 'an order exists' stays.

components.purpose: The signal checklist a decision was drawn from — the verdict counts legible before any interpretation is read.

actions.effect: Native details/summary disclosure — no client JS

components.current_implementation: details/summary: the counts line ('5 CONFIRM · 2 WARN · 1 REJECT across 8 signals') as the summary; rows on tokened left rails, verdict printed as the platform sent it.
constraints: Verdicts are printed as sent, never mapped to colour or icon — WARN is a third thing, and green/red teaches certainty the agent did not have.
The counts stay in the summary so the disagreement is legible before the interpretations.

components.current_implementation: Shared NotConnected component; treatment owned by DT-0006.

flows.name: Why didn't it trade
steps: walk blocked → evaluated → decided until the answer appears

accessibility.notes: Per-stage unreadable states carry role=alert. The Evidence disclosure is a native details element. No client JS.
